summary: This bill amends the Head Start Act to establish and maintain the Office of Head Start, including its central and 12 regional offices, with their pre-January 20, 2025 structure, staffing levels, and functions, and prohibits the Secretary of Health and Human Services from modifying this structure or reducing staffing without prior notice to Congress and the public.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on the Head Start program, which provides early childhood education and related services. By seeking to protect the program from elimination, restore regional offices, and maintain staffing levels, the bill aims to ensure and potentially increase the availability and effectiveness of these educational services, thus representing more spending on public education initiatives.
